label: Bible Study
prompt: Then will I _____ clean water upon you, and ye shall be clean: from all your filthiness, and from all your idols, will I cleanse you.
verse: Then will I sprinkle clean water upon you, and ye shall be clean: from all your filthiness, and from all your idols, will I cleanse you.
note: Clean water first, then a new heart and a new spirit in the very next verse.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Now therefore go, and I will be with thy _____, and teach thee what thou shalt say.
verse: Now therefore go, and I will be with thy mouth, and teach thee what thou shalt say.
note: Moses pleads he's 'slow of speech'; God reminds him who made man's mouth, and promises to be with his.

label: Sunday School
prompt: For Isaiah had said, Let them take a lump of _____, and lay it for a plaister upon the boil, and he shall recover.
verse: For Isaiah had said, Let them take a lump of figs, and lay it for a plaister upon the boil, and he shall recover.
note: Isaiah's prescription for King Hezekiah: a lump of figs laid on the boil — and the king recovered.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Because they met not the children of Israel with bread and with water, but hired Balaam against them, that he should curse them: howbeit our God turned the curse into a _____.
verse: Because they met not the children of Israel with bread and with water, but hired Balaam against them, that he should curse them: howbeit our God turned the curse into a blessing.
note: Balak hired Balaam to curse Israel, and every curse came out as a blessing.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Therefore thou art _____, O man, whosoever thou art that judgest: for wherein thou judgest another, thou condemnest thyself; for thou that judgest doest the same things.
verse: Therefore thou art inexcusable, O man, whosoever thou art that judgest: for wherein thou judgest another, thou condemnest thyself; for thou that judgest doest the same things.
note: Paul springs a trap: after condemning the pagan world in chapter 1, he turns on the judge — 'thou art inexcusable.'
